hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); b=$(basename "$f" 2>/dev/null); if [[ "$b" == .env* ]]; then jq -n '{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"PreToolUse",permissionDecision:"deny",permissionDecisionReason:"Blocked: editing .env* files is disabled to protect secrets (PRIVATE_KEY etc). Edit manually if intentional."}}'; fi
f=$(jq -r '.tool_response.filePath // .tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$f" in *.ts) npx eslint --fix "$f" 2>/dev/null; npx prettier --write "$f" 2>/dev/null ;; esac; true
